description: Provides information about the OS and device type the app is running on, along with platform-specific constants and methods.

isTesting.description: Whether the app is running in testing mode.

reactNativeVersion.description: RN version object: { major, minor, patch, prerelease }.

Version.description: OS version (number for Android, string for iOS).

isPad.description: Whether the device is an iPad.

isTV.description: Whether the device is a TV.

isVision.description: Whether the device is an Apple Vision (Vision Pro). Returns false on Vision Pro if isPad is true).

isTesting.description: Whether the app is running in Developer Mode with testing flag set.

Version.description: Current OS version (number for Android, string for iOS).

select.description: Returns the most appropriate value for the current platform.
select.signature: select(config: {android?: any, ios?: any, native?: any, default?: any}): any

config.description: Keys can be android, ios, native, default to provide platform-specific values.
